Winter Park Home Remodeling & Renovation

A Winter Park kitchen — and the dining end and the windows that came with it. Here the remodel rarely stops at one room.

BOOK YOUR COMPLIMENTARY CONSULTATION 407-499-8694

4.8★ GOOGLE · 63 REVIEWS  ·  WINTER PARK — 100+ PROJECTS OVER TWO DECADES  ·  FL LICENSE CGC 1529022

IN THESE STREETS

In Winter Park, the remodel almost never stays in one room.

DESIGN-BUILD REMODELING IN WINTER PARK, Orange County — more than a hundred Winter Park projects over two decades, 39 of them verified in our records and 33 of those inside 32789, part of 1,000+ completed projects across Central Florida. Kitchens, bathrooms, whole-home renovations, additions and interior design, from the brick streets of Olde Winter Park to the lakefront lots on the Chain of Lakes. Which building department the job answers to is decided by the address — the city's own division, or the county — and the filing is ours either way. Family-owned since 2003.

THAT IS THE REASON THIS PAGE EXISTS. A 1926 floor plan that finally gives up the wall between the kitchen and the dining room usually takes the living room with it. A midcentury ranch that wants a real primary bath often has to give up a bedroom to get one. Winter Park's housing stock keeps turning a room-sized question into a house-sized one — which is why every project here is designed and built by one team on one contract, through the same six-phase process, backed by a 5-year craftsmanship warranty. This page is the Winter Park hub of our Central Florida service areas; the room-by-room pages below go deeper than a hub can.

We are not in Winter Park, and we say so. The showroom is a short drive up Orlando Avenue in Maitland — close enough that choosing your stone is an errand, not a trip.

WHAT WE BUILD IN WINTER PARK

Five services, one team, one contract
PICTURED · WINTER PARK, FL
Custom Kitchen Remodeling

Full-gut kitchen remodels — cabinetry, stone, structural openings, lighting. The deep Winter Park version of this, street by street, is the Winter Park kitchen page.

PICTURED · WINTER PARK, FL
Custom Bathroom Remodeling

Primary suites, wet rooms and powder rooms — and, in the older stock, the cast-iron and galvanized plumbing behind the wall. Full detail on the Winter Park bathroom page.

PICTURED · WINTER PARK, FL
Whole-Home Remodeling

Winter Park is whole-home country, and two of ours are published start to finish: The White Oak Ranch and The Ivory Classic.

PICTURED · WINTER PARK, FL
Home Additions

New square footage tied into the original house honestly — and covered outdoor living, which on these lots is often the room the family actually gains. The covered patio above was added to the ranch in chapter 01.

PICTURED · WINTER PARK, FL
Interior Design

Concept, CAD, renderings and installation, from the studio that builds. The Winter Park practice has its own page.

THE NEIGHBORHOODS, SPECIFICALLY

What Winter Park's housing stock asks of a whole house
WINTER PARK · THE UNGLAMOROUS ROOMS GET THE SAME HAND
OLDE WINTER PARK & THE BRICK STREETS

1920s–40s Mediterranean Revival and Colonial homes on brick. Plaster, masonry, and original supply lines — open one room here and you are usually opening the house's structure and its plumbing in the same permit.

THE VIAS

The historic estate district. On a contributing structure the preservation board becomes one of the people the drawings have to satisfy. We would rather find that out at the drawing table than at the ordering desk.

INTERLACHEN & KENILWORTH

Midcentury ranches with chopped plans and low ceilings. One beam, correctly sized, is usually all that stands between these plans and daylight at the back of the house — and a bedroom nobody uses is usually where the primary suite comes from.

ISLE OF SICILY & THE CHAIN OF LAKES

Lakefront lots on Osceola, Virginia and Maitland. The whole plan turns toward the water: sightlines, glazing, and rooms that serve the lanai as much as the dining table.

WINDSONG

Newer estate footprints east of the lakes that arrive builder-finished. The work here is a specification pass over the whole house — cabinetry, stone, lighting, furnishings — rather than more square footage.

PARK AVENUE & THE TOWNHOMES

Condos and townhomes minutes from the Avenue. Compact plans, association approvals, shared walls and material access — logistics that get solved in the design phase so construction runs clean.

WINTER PARK · ONE STREET'S ANSWER, IN ONE ROOM

BEFORE & AFTER · WINTER PARK

You passed the plates through a gap.
Now there is no wall to pass them through.

The same room in a midcentury Winter Park ranch, looked at from both sides of the work. What you are looking through used to be a bank of cabinets hung over a peninsula — the kitchen on one side, the family on the other, and a countertop gap to hand things across. Five rooms' worth of partitions came out on a licensed Florida engineer's sealed drawings; the county signed off the framing before any drywall went back on. What is left is one room, and a fireplace this house never had. Drag the line.
Room-level pairing — the two frames were not shot from the same camera position.

THE WORK
AS FOUND
◂▸

WINTER PARK · THE FULL REMODELING STORY: THE WHITE OAK RANCH

WINTER PARK, ON THE RECORD

Real Winter Park projects, photographed at completion

Every photograph below is a KBF project in Winter Park, from our completion archive — no stock, no renders, no borrowed work. Four distinct projects plus a detail chapter. Three carry an as-found photograph of the same room; on the first of them the before is the family's own photograph.

BEFORE — THE SAME KITCHEN
01 · WINTER PARK · THE WHITE OAK RANCH — A MIDCENTURY RANCH TAKEN FORWARD IN ONE COMPREHENSIVE PASS · FULL CASE STUDY

A midcentury Winter Park ranch that one family had lived in long enough to wear out, and which they chose to fix in a single pass instead of a decade of weekends. Roof, windows, insulation, air conditioning and a new electrical panel went in first; everything anyone can actually see went in on top of that. The dark U-shaped kitchen — the family's own photograph is on the left — became an island kitchen that kept its sink window and gave up almost everything else. The whole house is published start to finish, permit file included.

02 · WINTER PARK · THE IVORY CLASSIC — A WHOLE-HOME REMODEL TOLD IN TWO PHASES · FULL CASE STUDY

Everything this family wanted was on paper before anything was ordered: the kitchen, wood floors carried through the main rooms, the stair, a wall in the gathering room built for the television — with the primary bath and the laundry held back deliberately as a second run of work. Two phases, one design direction: cream inset cabinetry and a paneled hood in the kitchen, and walnut returning as furniture-style vanity cabinetry in the bath. The kitchen has its own project page.

AS FOUND — THE SAME KITCHEN, AT MOVE-IN
03 · WINTER PARK · THE REEDED-OAK & PLASTER KITCHEN — THE LAKE SET THE PALETTE, THE ROOM KEEPS IT · FULL PROJECT PAGE

A Winter Park home whose soaring windows look out over Lake Maitland, where the brief was to make the view inside as good as the one outside without competing with it. The answer was a material language rather than a colour story: soft-white cabinetry, a hand-finished plaster hood banded in white oak, reeded oak at the foot of the waterfall edge, and an arched, lit, oak-lined niche where wall cabinets would have gone. The left-hand photograph is the room as the clients found it the week they moved in — flat-slab cabinetry, appliances still wrapped, nothing yet theirs.

AS FOUND — THE SAME KITCHEN
04 · WINTER PARK · THE RIFT-OAK & MARBLE TOWNHOME — ONE ISLAND, TURNED NINETY DEGREES · FULL PROJECT PAGE

The compact-footprint answer, minutes from Park Avenue. The original island ran horizontally with a high-low counter that walled the kitchen off from the living area; rotating it opened the plan without moving a single wall. Rift-cut oak with long quiet grain, one uninterrupted marble waterfall, and glass to the pool courtyard so the daylight does the work. The as-found photograph, high-low counter and all, is on the right.

05 · THE DETAILS — THE TOWNHOME POWDER ROOM, CHAPTER 02’S KITCHEN FROM ANOTHER ANGLE, THE NICHE FROM CHAPTER 01

PERMITS, BOARDS & PAPERWORK

Winter Park permitting, in plain language

Addresses inside the city limits permit through the City of Winter Park's Building Division; the surrounding pockets permit through Orange County. Establishing which one your address falls under is step one; the permit is then pulled under Florida license CGC 1529022, and every inspection is written into the build calendar as a date rather than discovered as an interruption. Historic districts add a third party: on a contributing structure some changes go in front of the Historic Preservation Board, and that gets raised while the plan is still a drawing.

The other Winter Park paperwork is structural. In the 1920s–40s stock, the partition you most want gone is frequently the one carrying the roof; in the midcentury ranches it is rarely more than a single beam between the plan you have and the plan you wanted. None of that is decided with a sledgehammer. Somebody measures what is actually there, the beam and the posts under it get sized for the load they will carry down to the footing, and where the code asks for it a licensed structural engineer seals the drawing. The same is true of the plumbing those walls hide. The full six-phase structure is on the process page, and selections happen in person at the showroom on South Orlando Avenue, minutes up the road in Maitland.

IN THESE STREETS

There are two Windermeres. We build in both.

Design-build remodeling in Windermere, Orange County — kitchens, bathrooms, whole-home renovations and additions, delivered by one team on one contract. Fifty-plus Windermere projects over two decades, part of 1,000+ completed projects across Central Florida. KBF Design Gallery has been family-owned since 2003 and designs from a showroom in Maitland, about half an hour up the road.

Four miles separates the oak-canopied dirt streets of the downtown historic district from the guard houses of Isleworth and Keene's Pointe, and the two ask a remodeler for opposite things: one wants proportion, restraint, and a permit through the Town of Windermere; the other wants estate scale, an architectural review board satisfied, and a gate that lets the trades in on schedule. This page is the Windermere parent of everything we publish about the town — the kitchen practice here, the bathroom practice here, and the projects underneath both. It sits inside our Central Florida service areas.

Every project runs through the same six-phase process and ships under a 5-year craftsmanship warranty, whether it is one bathroom on a dirt road or a four-acre estate taken back to its studs.

Windermere is the only town we work in where the same week can hold a cottage on a clay road and a lakefront estate behind a gate. Fifty-plus projects here taught us both languages.

WHAT WE BUILD IN WINDERMERE

Five services, one team, one contract
PICTURED · WINDERMERE, FL
Custom Kitchen Remodeling

Full-gut kitchen remodels — cabinetry, stone, structural openings, lighting. The town's own kitchen record is on the Windermere kitchen page, with the arched-hutch kitchen published start to finish.

PICTURED · WINDERMERE, FL
Custom Bathroom Remodeling

Owners'-suite conversions, wet rooms, steam showers and guest baths. Windermere's bath work — including a 2025 first-place primary bath — is collected on the Windermere bathroom page.

PICTURED · WINDERMERE, FL
Whole-Home Remodeling

Windermere is whole-home country — both of the town's published case studies began as one room and became the house. The estate whole-home remodel is published in full.

PICTURED · ORLANDO, FL
Home Additions

Extended living space and the structural work that ties new square footage into the original house honestly. On Butler Chain lots and inside built-out gated communities, an addition is often the only way the plan grows.

PICTURED · CENTRAL FLORIDA
Interior Design

The design half of design-build — selections, finishes and furnishing direction from the same studio that builds the work, chosen in person at the showroom.

THE NEIGHBORHOODS, SPECIFICALLY

What Windermere's housing stock asks of a remodel
ISLEWORTH

Guard-gated estates on the Butler Chain. The schedule lives or dies on gate access and architectural review — we manage both as part of the contract.

KEENE'S POINTE

Golf-and-lake estate stock behind the Golden Bear Club — big plans with builder-grade interiors that never matched the architecture.

DOWNTOWN WINDERMERE HISTORIC DISTRICT

Oak canopy and clay streets between Lake Down and Lake Butler. Cottage-scale homes, proportion work, and Town of Windermere permitting.

WINDERMERE DOWNS

Established 1970s–90s family homes on Lake Down — the wall-removal projects, where an engineered beam turns three small rooms into one plan.

THE BUTLER CHAIN LAKEFRONT

Lots on Butler, Down, Tibet and the rest of the chain. Every plan turns toward the water: sightlines, glazing, and a lanai that works as hard as the dining room.

WOODLANDS OF WINDERMERE

The established non-gated neighborhoods on the town's eastern approach, reaching remodel age together. Chapter 03 below is a kitchen here.

PICTURED · WINDERMERE, FL — THE GATED-ESTATE STOCK, REMODELED. THE ROOM-BY-ROOM KITCHEN RECORD IS ON THE WINDERMERE KITCHEN PAGE.

BEFORE & AFTER · WINDERMERE

The house had one arch.
We gave it three.

A 2006 Mediterranean kitchen, fully gutted. The cherry cabinetry and corbelled granite peninsula came out, a wall section came down, and where the room had one arched doorway the plan framed two new nine-foot arches plus a third recess built to receive a glass-front hutch. The architecture the house already had was not fought — it was multiplied. Drag the line.

THE WORK
AS FOUND
◂▸

BOTH PHOTOGRAPHS ARE THIS ACTUAL WINDERMERE KITCHEN, from the project's own file — the first from the pre-construction survey, the second from the completion set. The two frames were not shot from the same camera position; nothing is staged, borrowed or generated.

WINDERMERE · THE FULL REMODELING STORY: THE LANTERN CLASSIC

WINDERMERE, ON THE RECORD

Real Windermere projects, photographed at completion

Every photograph below is a KBF project in Windermere, from our completion archive — no stock, no renders, no borrowed work. Chapter 03 carries the homeowners' own before photograph; the reveal above is a second.

01 · WINDERMERE · THE ESTATE WHOLE-HOME — FOUR WOODED ACRES, AND THE RAREST CALL IN REMODELING: NO BEAM NEEDED · READ THE CASE STUDY

A family bought an established estate on more than four acres of oak canopy and asked for the back of the house to open to the trees. The instinct on a dated estate is to start pulling walls out; the survey said otherwise, and the brightness they wanted turned out to be a partition problem, not a structural one. Travertine and heavy cabinetry gave way to white oak, warm brass and honed marble — and not one structural wall moved. The whole house is documented as a case study and published as a project gallery.

02 · WINDERMERE · THE LANTERN CLASSIC — KITCHEN, ENTERTAINMENT WALL AND POOL BATH, DRAWN AS ONE PLAN SET · READ THE CASE STUDY

A 2006 Mediterranean home with good bones and a dated interior. Rather than fight the architecture, the plan built more of it — new arched entries where walls came down, a purpose-framed recess to hold the hutch, and a curved riveted hood answering the millwork. Kitchen, entertainment wall and pool bath were drawn on numbered sheets before a single trade walked in. The kitchen is published as a project gallery; the drawing set is quoted in the case study.

BEFORE — THE SAME KITCHEN
03 · WOODLANDS OF WINDERMERE · THE SALTILLO-FLOOR KITCHEN — A NEW FOOTPRINT ON A FLOOR THE CLIENTS REFUSED TO LOSE · FULL PROJECT GALLERY

The footprint changed: the entryway shifted for the new oven wall, the peninsula came out, and an island with banquette seating replaced it. The one thing that did not change was the Mexican tile floor the homeowners loved — raw Saltillo was woven in where the plan moved, then the whole field was re-stained so old and new read as one surface. Anyone can demolish a floor; weaving into one is the craft. The homeowners' own before photograph is on the left.

04 · WINDERMERE · THE OWNERS' SUITE — A FIRST-PLACE PRIMARY BATH, AND THE CALMEST ROOM IN THE HOUSE

A full owners'-suite conversion where bedroom, closet and bath were carried by one plan. Patterned marble mosaic underfoot, a mirrored tub alcove, the bedroom framed through an arch. In 2025 a Windermere spa retreat took first place for best traditional/transitional primary bathroom from Florida Design's Seaglass jury — one of two first places the jury gave KBF that year, both for Windermere homes. Both hang in The Winners, and the town's bath record is on the Windermere bathroom page.

05 · WINDERMERE · THREE MORE FROM THE FILE — A COMMISSIONED BRONZE HOOD, AN OUTDOOR KITCHEN, A PAPERED BATH

Three further Windermere homes, one photograph each. An estate kitchen built around a commissioned hammered-bronze hood over chevron marble. A summer kitchen that put grill, burners and refrigeration on the lanai, because Windermere living does not stop at the sliders. And a primary bath with a point of view — botanical paper above a tiled wainscot, warm brass at the shower. The kitchens are collected on the Windermere kitchen page; the baths on the Windermere bathroom page.

PERMITS, BOARDS & GATES

PICTURED · WINDERMERE, FL — OUTDOOR LIVING ON A WINDERMERE LOT. PERMITS PULLED UNDER FL LICENSE CGC 1529022.
Windermere permitting, in plain language

Windermere runs on two jurisdictions, and most homeowners do not know which one they live in. Inside the town limits, permits go through the Town of Windermere; outside them — including most of the gated communities — they go through Orange County. We determine which applies to your address, pull the permits under Florida license CGC 1529022, and sequence the inspections into the schedule so they gate the work instead of surprising it.

BEHIND THE GATES THERE IS A THIRD LAYER that has nothing to do with government: the architectural review board, and the gate itself. An ARB wants a complete submittal the first time; a guard house wants trade access booked and working hours respected. We prepare the submittal and carry the community's rules into the construction plan, so review is a step rather than a stall.

On Butler Chain lakefront lots there can be a fourth layer — work reaching the shoreline or a dock can pull in review beyond the building permit, and we identify that at design, not at demolition. Structural changes are always confirmed by field verification and, where required, a licensed engineer's design. The full six-phase structure is on the process page.

A CLIENT, VERBATIM

“You helped me envision our dream and elevated it beyond what I could have imagined. … It is airy, bright, minimal and provides a place we love coming home to. It is peaceful and calm. … Our realtor told us that it’s a one of a kind.”

MAITLAND · ORANGE COUNTY · OUR HOME TOWN

Maitland Home Remodeling & Renovation
— Kitchens, Baths, Whole-Home & Additions
BOOK YOUR COMPLIMENTARY CONSULTATION 407-499-8694

4.8★ GOOGLE · 63 REVIEWS  ·  MAITLAND — 30+ PROJECTS OVER TWO DECADES  ·  FL LICENSE CGC 1529022

IN THESE STREETS

Maitland isn't a service area for us. It's the home address.

Design-build remodeling in Maitland, Orange County — thirty-plus Maitland projects over two decades, part of 1,000+ completed projects across Central Florida. Kitchens, bathrooms, whole-home renovations, and additions, from the mid-century lakefront streets around Lake Sybelia to the estates of Dommerich. Permits here run through the City of Maitland's building division with Orange County as the surrounding jurisdiction, and we handle them as part of every job. Family-owned since 2003.

Since 2020, our design showroom has stood at 1295 South Orlando Avenue — in Maitland itself, a few minutes from every neighborhood on this page (the opening was a hometown story). THE HOUSING STOCK REWARDS THAT CLOSENESS: much of Maitland was built mid-century around its lakes, and those 1960s–80s floor plans are exactly the ones asking for walls to come out and kitchens to open up. Every project is designed and built by one team on one contract, through the same six-phase process, backed by a 5-year craftsmanship warranty. This page is the Maitland hub of our Central Florida service areas.

Every remodeler says they'll treat your town like home. Our showroom's mailing address makes it literal — the selections table for your project sits inside Maitland's own city limits.

WHAT WE BUILD IN MAITLAND

Five services, one team, one contract
PICTURED · CELEBRATION, FL
Custom Kitchen Remodeling

Full-gut kitchen remodels and renovations — cabinetry, stone, structural openings, lighting. See the Dommerich Estates kitchen from chapter 02 published start to finish.

PICTURED · CENTRAL FLORIDA
Custom Bathroom Remodeling

Primary suites, wet rooms, and guest baths built to spa standard — designed at the Maitland showroom, built in your home.

PICTURED · WINTER PARK, FL
Whole-Home Remodeling

Maitland's mid-century stock is whole-home territory — two of the four projects below are gut-to-gorgeous transformations, including a published 1960s whole-home remodel.

PICTURED · ORLANDO, FL
Home Additions

Extended living space and the structural work that ties new square footage into the original house honestly — on lake lots, often the smarter alternative to moving.

PICTURED · CENTRAL FLORIDA
Interior Design

The design half of design-build — selections, finishes, and furnishing direction from the same studio that builds the work, chosen in person at the showroom on South Orlando Avenue.

THE NEIGHBORHOODS, SPECIFICALLY

What Maitland's housing stock asks of a remodel
DOMMERICH ESTATES & DOMMERICH HILLS

The estate streets toward the Winter Park line — larger mid-century homes on generous lots. Chapter 02 below is a Dommerich Estates project, published start to finish.

LAKE SYBELIA

The lakefront and near-lake streets around Maitland's signature lake — chapter 04 below is a Lake Sybelia whole-home, photographed at completion.

HISTORIC MAITLAND & LAKE LILY

The blocks around Lake Lily Park and the town's historic core — older homes where a remodel answers to real character, not just a floor plan.

KAYWOOD

The established neighborhood on the city's west side — 1960s–70s single-stories whose kitchens and baths are ready to become permanent.

SYLVAN LAKE & LAKE CATHERINE

The smaller-lake pockets threaded through the city — mid-century homes where the remodel conversation usually starts with light and sightlines to the water.

SOUTH ORLANDO AVENUE

The 17-92 corridor — our own address. The KBF design showroom sits here at 1295 South Orlando Avenue, inside Maitland's city limits.

BEFORE & AFTER · MAITLAND

A wall made it a galley.
Taking it out made it the room.

The Maitland whole-home renovation, kitchen first — the same room the film at the top of this page pans across. The wall that closed the kitchen off came out, the tile counters and terracotta floor went with it, and a quartz peninsula now seats three where the doorway used to be, with the sightline running clear through to the living room. Drag the line.

THE WORK
AS FOUND
◂▸

MAITLAND · THE FULL REMODELING STORY: THE MAITLAND WHOLE-HOME

MAITLAND, ON THE RECORD

Real Maitland projects, photographed at completion

Every photograph below is a KBF project in Maitland, from our completion archive — no stock, no renders, no borrowed work. Four distinct projects; three include the homeowners' actual before photos. Chapter 01 is the whole-home in the film and the reveal above, room by room.

BEFORE — THE HEARTH ROOM
AFTER — THE SAME WALL
BEFORE — THE PRIMARY BATH
AFTER — THE SAME VANITY WALL
01 · MAITLAND · THE WHOLE-HOME — THE HOUSE IN THE FILM ABOVE, ROOM BY ROOM · FULL PROJECT GALLERY

This is the same Maitland house you see in the film at the top of the page and in the reveal above — a home that had not been touched since the 1960s, and our clients asked us to take on all of it at once. The hearth room lost its stained beams and its red brick: the fireplace came back in pale glazed brick with a marble firebox, the built-ins came back in white, and the room it heats is now the dining room. Down the hall, a cultured-marble double vanity under one big framed mirror became a black vanity with brass fittings and twin oval mirrors on a shiplap wall. The homeowners' own before photographs are on the left of each pair, and the whole project is published start to finish.

BEFORE — THE SAME KITCHEN
02 · MAITLAND · THE DOMMERICH ESTATES KITCHEN — THE PENINSULA RETIRED, A GRAND ISLAND LANDED · FULL PROJECT GALLERY

Our clients built this Dommerich Estates home in 1986 and were ready for its kitchen to catch up. Removing the peninsula made room for a grand center island — black base, white waterfall counter, brass-and-black linear chandelier overhead — and opened the flow to the living area beyond, so the kitchen feels far larger without adding a single square foot. The homeowners' own before photo, teal tile and all, is on the right.

BEFORE — THE SAME KITCHEN
03 · MAITLAND · THE WISHBONE-ISLAND KITCHEN — TRAVERTINE, PATTERN TILE, AND A DARK ISLAND TO HOLD IT DOWN

A dark-cherry kitchen with tan granite gave way to something lighter but not weightless: white perimeter cabinetry against travertine-toned tile, a blue-patterned inset framed over the range, and a furniture-grade dark island under dome pendants, ringed with wishbone stools. The homeowners' own before photo is on the left — same room, a full register brighter.

04 · MAITLAND · THE LAKE SYBELIA WHOLE-HOME — VAULTED SHIPLAP, A CORBELED HOOD, A CRAFTSMAN STAIR

A whole-home transformation on Lake Sybelia, photographed at completion: the kitchen got a dark furniture-look island under clear glass pendants and a corbeled custom hood beneath the vaulted shiplap ceiling, and the staircase — white craftsman newels, wood treads under that same shiplap — is part of the completed project. The only before photos in our file for this one are the home's old real-estate listing shots, which aren't ours to republish — so this chapter shows only our finished work.

05 · THE DETAILS — CLOSE-UPS AND ONE MORE ROOM FROM THE PROJECTS ABOVE

The last chapter looks closer: the wine-cooler beverage center under its white-oak shelf from chapter 02, the black-on-white drawer hardware and pattern tile from chapter 03, and the freestanding tub and brass filler from the chapter-01 whole-home. All three photographs are from the Maitland projects above — the finish level is the point.

PERMITS, BOARDS & HOAS

Maitland permitting, in plain language

Addresses inside the city limits permit through the City of Maitland's building division; the surrounding pockets permit through Orange County. We determine which applies to your address, pull the permits under Florida license CGC 1529022, and sequence the inspections into the construction schedule so they gate the work instead of surprising it.

MAITLAND'S OLDER LAKEFRONT STREETS can add review layers of their own — lakeside setbacks and, on some properties, dock and shoreline rules that shape an addition before the first drawing. We carry those constraints into the construction plan from day one, so the review is a step, not a stall. The full six-phase structure is on the process page — and here, uniquely, the selections trip is a hometown errand: the showroom is on South Orlando Avenue, inside the same city limits your permit comes from.

A CLIENT, VERBATIM

“I thoroughly enjoyed working with the team at KBF every step of the way through our project. We have shown our finished project to many curious neighbors, and have encouraged them to reach out to KBF in the future.”
THE BUTLERS · ORLANDO · POOL, LANAI & SUMMER KITCHEN · CLIENT TESTIMONIAL, VERBATIM

Their actual home — an outdoor-living build in neighboring Orlando. We don't yet have a verified review-and-photo pair from a Maitland client; when one exists, it will live here — never a borrowed one. More verified pairs on the reviews page.

THE RECORD

Numbers that hold up in records

KBF Design Gallery was founded in 2003 and has remained family-owned since. Two decades of work here add up to 30+ Maitland projects — part of 1,000+ completed projects across Central Florida (a derived count from 22 years of files). Every project ships under the 5-year craftsmanship warranty.
